title: Try it safely — the practice run
description: The sandboxed practice run: teach one sample document by drawing boxes, import a small batch, correct one uncertain value and confirm — all over bundled fixtures, so nothing touches your real files, folders or settings. References the welcome tour in passing (that tour has its own video). Opened from the Practice run card on Home.

steps.narration: You've seen the welcome tour — this is the hands-on version: a safe practice run on sample documents, so nothing touches your real files.
steps.caption: A safe rehearsal on sample documents

steps.narration: Open it from the Practice run card on Home.
steps.caption: Open the practice run

steps.narration: A banner reminds you these are only samples. Click Start to begin.
steps.caption: 1. Start

steps.narration: First, you teach one document — point out each detail by drawing a box around its value, and it remembers where to look.
steps.caption: Step 1: teach one document

steps.narration: Start with the company name — drag a box across it and release.
steps.caption: Draw a box: the company

steps.narration: Now the reference — box the invoice number.
steps.caption: Draw a box: the reference

steps.narration: And the date. Every box you draw teaches it where that detail sits.
steps.caption: Draw a box: the date

steps.narration: All three taught. Save the lesson and it files this one — and remembers this sender's layout for next time.
steps.caption: 2. Save and file the taught doc

steps.narration: Now import a batch — two more scans. Click Process and it reads them.
steps.caption: Step 2: import the batch

steps.narration: In Review you check what it read. This invoice number is uncertain: the scan turned a zero into an O. Click and type the correct value.
steps.caption: Step 3: fix the uncertain value

steps.narration: Confirm, and it files — and learns from your correction too.
steps.caption: Confirm and file

steps.narration: The last document is from a new sender and reads cleanly: just confirm it.
steps.caption: Confirm the last one

steps.narration: That's the whole method: teach one, import, correct a detail, confirm. Each document is filed with a tidy name under company, year and month.
steps.caption: Filed by company, year, month

steps.narration: And it was all a sandbox: your real files were never touched. Try it whenever you're ready.
steps.caption: Nothing real was touched
